title: Audit Evidence Builder + Customer Residency/Retention Controls (console + API)
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Deliver a self-serve Audit Evidence Builder and customer-facing residency/retention controls that let customers respond to audit requests and DPAs with a single export. This includes: (1) a console UI and API for toggling per-customer data residency targets, (2) retention policy settings with validation and enforcement, and (3) an evidence bundle generator that collects configuration, logs, access lists, encryption metadata, and questionnaire responses into a tamper-evident artifact for customers and auditors.
background: Customers continue to ask for faster responses to compliance/audit requests (SOC2, GDPR DSRs, contractual DPA items). Currently support manually compiles evidence and executes data residency changes with SRE help. This is time-consuming and error-prone. We need productized controls and an evidence automation flow that reduces manual effort and creates a repeatable, auditable export.
goals: (1) Reduce mean time to deliver compliance evidence from days to hours for common requests. (2) Provide a console and API that allow customers to set a preferred data residency region and retention policy per dataset/route. (3) Produce an exportable, signed evidence bundle suitable for contractual audits and DPA attachments.
scope_in: Console residency toggle, API residency flag, retention policy UI and API, evidence bundle generator (config + logs + questionnaire responses + KMS key IDs + model/catalog versions), signed artifact with checksum, UX flows for audit requests and DPA exports, role-based access control for generation.
scope_out: Automated cross-region data migration orchestration (we will queue migration jobs but SRE will run heavy migrations in a follow-up), in-depth legal review templates for unique customer DPAs, enterprise-only professional services offering.
success_metrics: Time to deliver evidence (hours) reduced by 70% for standard request types; number of self-service evidence exports initiated by customers; reduction in support tickets labeled compliance by 50%; adoption of residency toggle by 30% of paying customers within 6 months.
stakeholders: PM: Aisha Raman; Eng: Diego Marquez (owner), Priya Shah (privacy lead); Design: Rowan Lee; Legal: Sandra Ko; Security/Compliance: Omar Idris; Support: Lina Chen.
assumptions: (1) We can query 90 days of relevant logs (console/API/infra) via existing observability exports. (2) KMS/HSM metadata is available via current key management integrations. (3) Customers will accept a signed ZIP with metadata rather than direct access to system internals for initial audits.
requirements: - Console: per-customer residency dropdown (region list) + retention policy slider and presets. - API: /customers/{id}/compliance with residency_region and retention_days fields. - Evidence builder endpoint: POST /customers/{id}/evidence-exports that returns a signed URL to a ZIP. - Evidence bundle contents standardized and documented. - RBAC: only users with specific account role can generate/download. - Audit trail: record who generated export and when with immutable event ID.
api_changes: Add endpoint: POST /v1/customers/{customer_id}/compliance (body: {"residency_region": "eu-west-1", "retention_days": 365}). Add endpoint: POST /v1/customers/{customer_id}/evidence-exports -> {"export_id", "status", "download_url"}. GET /v1/evidence-exports/{export_id} for status and logs.
console_changes: New Compliance tab under Customer settings. Residency control (info tooltip explaining implications), retention policy presets (30/90/365/forever), Evidence export wizard (select scope: routes/models/logs/questionnaires), progress UI, signed artifact download button, recent export history table.
data_model_changes: Customer.compliance_residency_region (string), Customer.retention_days (int), EvidenceExport (export_id,string status,string actor,string artifacts_list,string checksum,string signed_by), ComplianceAuditLog events appended to account activity stream.
workflow: 1) Customer or support creates evidence export via console or API. 2) System validates RBAC and retention/residency config. 3) Export job collects configuration (model pins, routing policies), last N days of access logs, questionnaire responses, KMS key IDs, and retention settings. 4) Artifact is packaged, signed with our export-signing key, checksum produced, and stored in a short-lived S3 bucket. 5) Customer receives a download URL and audit entry is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: - Residency and retention settings visible and editable in console and via API. - Evidence export returns a signed ZIP containing at minimum: customer-config.json, policy-mapping.json, access-logs.csv (last 90 days by default), questionnaire_responses.json, kms_keys.json, export_manifest.json. - Export includes checksum and signature. - RBAC prevents non-privileged users from generating exports. - Full E2E test in staging with a seeded customer account and sample logs. - Documentation page and export schema published (Confluence + API docs).
milestones: 2026-02-25: Design prototype and schema. 2026-03-10: API + backend stubbed and job queue created. 2026-03-24: Console UI implemented and QA. 2026-04-07: Security/legal review complete. 2026-04-15: GA release and release notes.
risks: - Large exports may hit storage/egress limits; need quota guardrails. - Privacy risk if export includes PII; need filters and data minimization. - Signing key compromise risk; rotate policy required. - Customers may request different artifact formats, increasing scope.
mitigations: - Implement size limits and sampling heuristics for logs. - Review export fields with Privacy and redact PII by default unless explicitly requested with justification. - Use HSM-backed signing and generate short-lived signed URLs. - Provide an extension point for custom artifact templates as follow-up.
notes: Design mockups in Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/compliance-evidence. Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COMPLIANCE/Evidence+Builder. Initial implementation ticket for backend: ENG-2257. Support runbook draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ComplianceRunbooks.
open_questions: - Should the default log retention window for exports be 90 days or configurable per export? - Do customers require signed S3 objects or is a ZIP with signature sufficient for legal teams? - What SLA do we commit for export generation time for typical customers?
decisions: - Use ZIP + detached signature for first release. - Default export window set to 90 days with console option to change scope per export. - RBAC aligned with existing account admin role; no new roles this release.
follow_up_tasks: - ENG: Implement migration plan for existing customers with residency requests (separate project). - PM: Draft customer announcement and docs. - Legal: Provide DPA appendix template referencing evidence export format. - Support: Train support engineers on export troubleshooting.
